commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production texture for Unity cute cat poker deck 'Cat Court'. ONE single playing card face, portrait EXACT aspect ratio 17:24, requested output 1088x1536. Flat orthographic printable art, not a photograph or mockup. Card fills entire canvas, no surrounding background, no drop shadow or perspective; solid flat warm ivory #FFFCF5 face, gently rounded corners with transparent corner pixels. Thin inset border at 3.5% of width, red on red suits, charcoal on black suits. Consistent corner indices: bold readable serif rank centered at x=12%, y=10%, height 10% of card; standard suit glyph immediately beneath at x=12%, y=19%, width 9%. Bottom-right has identical rank/suit pair rotated 180 degrees. Corner suit glyphs are ALWAYS normal standard suits, never cat faces. No other text, watermark, labels or scenery. Cute large amber eyes, tiny pink nose, gentle smile, elegant refined 2D illustration, soft minimal shading. IMPORTANT all number cards A through 10 have exactly ONE centered suit-shaped cat HEAD without body, regardless of numerical rank, never repeated pips. Cat-head emblem centered x50% y50%, maximum width 55%, height 38%, generous ivory whitespace. Emblem silhouette itself preserves the standard suit geometry; not a round cat pasted onto a separate symbol.

suitPrompts.Heart: HEARTS, red ink. The one central red cat head has a dominant HEART silhouette: two rounded upper lobes with deep center cleft, tapering pointed bottom chin; subtle integrated ears atop the lobes, face inside the heart shape, three tiny whisker marks each cheek.
suitPrompts.Diamond: DIAMONDS, red ink. The one central red cat head has a dominant DIAMOND RHOMBUS silhouette: sharp top point, left and right cheek vertices, sharp bottom chin and four diagonal edges. Tiny ear folds integrated into upper diagonals without losing the unmistakable diamond outline, cute face inside the diamond, tiny whisker marks on cheeks. NOT a heart.
suitPrompts.Club: CLUBS, black ink. The one central charcoal cat head has a dominant CLUB silhouette: THREE distinct round lobes (one round top lobe and two side cheek lobes), with short broad stem centered below. Tiny cat ears integrated at upper shoulders, face within the lobes, subtle whisker marks. The top stays ROUND, NOT pointed: unmistakable club, not spade.
suitPrompts.Spade: SPADES, black ink. The one central charcoal cat head has a dominant SPADE silhouette: pronounced top point, two rounded lower cheek lobes, short flared stem beneath center. Tiny cat ears integrated in sloping upper shoulders, cute face inside spade shape, delicate whisker marks. Unmistakable standard spade geometry.
